title: Design and Create Enhanced Navbar Component
description: Create a new reusable navbar component with improved visual design, better navigation structure, and responsive behavior
details: Build a new navbar component in `/app/components/Navbar.tsx` that includes: brand logo/title, navigation links (Dashboard, Analytics, Reports placeholders), user profile dropdown with logout option, responsive hamburger menu for mobile, and improved styling with proper spacing, typography, and hover effects. Use TypeScript interfaces for props and ensure the component is modular and reusable across different layouts.
test_strategy: Test navbar rendering, responsive behavior across different screen sizes, dropdown functionality, and navigation link interactions. Verify accessibility with keyboard navigation and screen readers.

title: Implement Navbar Styling and Theme Integration
description: Create comprehensive CSS styles for the navbar component that integrate with the existing theme system
details: Create `/app/components/Navbar.module.css` or add navbar styles to `theme.css` with: consistent color scheme matching dashboard theme, proper z-index layering, smooth transitions and hover effects, responsive breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop, dropdown menu styling, and proper contrast ratios for accessibility. Ensure styles don't conflict with existing global styles and follow the established design patterns.
test_strategy: Verify visual consistency across different pages, test responsive behavior, validate color contrast ratios, and ensure no CSS conflicts with existing styles.

title: Integrate Enhanced Navbar into Dashboard Layout
description: Replace the existing basic header in the dashboard layout with the new enhanced navbar component
details: Update `/app/dashboard/layout.tsx` to import and use the new Navbar component. Remove or refactor the existing header implementation, ensure proper props are passed to the navbar (user info, current page context), and maintain the existing layout structure while improving the visual hierarchy. Update any related TypeScript types and ensure the layout remains responsive.
test_strategy: Test dashboard layout rendering, verify navbar integration doesn't break existing functionality, check responsive behavior, and validate that logout and navigation features work correctly within the dashboard context.

title: Add Navigation State Management and Active Link Highlighting
description: Implement navigation state management to highlight the current active page and improve user experience
details: Add functionality to track the current route using Next.js `usePathname` hook, implement active link highlighting in the navbar, add breadcrumb functionality if needed, and ensure smooth navigation transitions. Update the navbar component to accept current page context and style active navigation items appropriately. Consider adding navigation history or back button functionality for better UX.
test_strategy: Test active link highlighting across different dashboard pages, verify navigation state updates correctly, test browser back/forward functionality, and ensure navigation indicators are accessible and visually clear.
